title: Creating Custom Specs
text: code_spec() creates new CodeSpec scratch. Provide short condition ID, label, named list code vectors: resulting spec object $get_codes() method returns tibble:
code: my_htn <- code_spec(   condition = "my_htn",   label     = "Hypertension (study version)",   version   = "v1",   codes     = list(     dx_icd9  = c("4010", "4011", "4019"),     dx_icd10 = c("I10")   ) )  my_htn #>  #> ── Hypertension (study version) (v1) ─────────────────────────────────────────── #> Condition: `my_htn` #> Code sets: #>   `dx_icd9`: 3 condition / 3 outcome codes #>   `dx_icd10`: 1 condition / 1 outcome codes my_htn$get_codes(code_type = "dx_icd10") #> # A tibble: 1 × 4 #>   type     code  priority version #>   <chr>    <chr>    <int> <chr>   #> 1 dx_icd10 I10          1 v1

title: Creating Custom Specs
text: drug_spec() creates DrugSpec vector generic names:
code: my_thiazide <- drug_spec(   drug_class    = "my_thiazide",   label         = "Thiazide Diuretics (study subset)",   version       = "v1",   generic_names = c("HYDROCHLOROTHIAZIDE", "CHLORTHALIDONE", "INDAPAMIDE") )  my_thiazide$get_generics() #> # A tibble: 3 × 6 #>   generic             brand     priority condition class       version #>   <chr>               <list>       <int> <chr>     <chr>       <chr>   #> 1 HYDROCHLOROTHIAZIDE <chr [0]>        1 NA        my_thiazide v1      #> 2 CHLORTHALIDONE      <chr [0]>        1 NA        my_thiazide v1      #> 3 INDAPAMIDE          <chr [0]>        1 NA        my_thiazide v1

what: Adding codes to a bundled spec
title: Creating Custom Specs
text: add_codes() returns modified deep clone spec additional codes merged . ... argument names must valid code-set keys. original never modified: default, added codes flagged condition outcome. Use variable_type restrict membership:
code: # Inspect available keys spec_hypertension_v1$keys() #> [1] "dx_icd9"  "dx_icd10"  # Add a code and confirm the clone grew; original is unchanged htn_plus <- add_codes(spec_hypertension_v1, dx_icd10 = c("I99"))  nrow(htn_plus$get_codes(code_type = "dx_icd10"))     # clone #> [1] 24 nrow(spec_hypertension_v1$get_codes(code_type = "dx_icd10"))  # original #> [1] 23 htn_outcome_only <- add_codes(   spec_hypertension_v1,   variable_type = "outcome",   dx_icd10      = c("I99") )

what: Removing codes from a bundled spec
title: Creating Custom Specs
text: remove_codes() returns clone specified codes excluded:
code: htn_trimmed <- remove_codes(spec_hypertension_v1, dx_icd9 = c("4019"))  # Code removed from clone; original is unchanged "4019" %in% htn_trimmed$get_codes(code_type = "dx_icd9")$code #> [1] FALSE "4019" %in% spec_hypertension_v1$get_codes(code_type = "dx_icd9")$code #> [1] TRUE

title: Creating Custom Specs
text: modify_code_spec() can update label, narrative definitions, replace code sets: create new version, construct new code_spec() object directly rather modifying existing one. keeps version explicit self-contained:
code: htn_revised <- modify_code_spec(   spec  = spec_hypertension_v1,   label = "Hypertension (revised)",   defs  = list(     condition = c("i" = "Study-specific hypertension definition."),     outcome   = NULL   ) )  htn_revised #>  #> ── Hypertension (revised) (v1) ───────────────────────────────────────────────── #> Condition: `hypertension` #> Condition def: #> ℹ Study-specific hypertension definition. #>  #> Code sets: #>   `dx_icd9`: 13 condition / 0 outcome codes #>   `dx_icd10`: 23 condition / 0 outcome codes spec_my_htn_v2 <- code_spec(   condition = "my_htn",   label     = "Hypertension (study v2)",   version   = "v2",   defs      = list(     condition = c("i" = "Expanded definition including I11.x and I13.x."),     outcome   = NULL   ),   codes = list(     dx_icd10 = c("I10", "I110", "I119", "I130", "I132")   ) )  spec_my_htn_v2 #>  #> ── Hypertension (study v2) (v2) ──────────────────────────────────────────────── #> Condition: `my_htn` #> Condition def: #> ℹ Expanded definition including I11.x and I13.x. #>  #> Code sets: #>   `dx_icd10`: 5 condition / 5 outcome codes

title: Working with Drug Specs
text: priority column distinguishes confident generic name belongs drug class definition: 1 (core) default conservative tier, 2 (probable) covers generics one indication, 3 (cautious) covers generics without expected indication US. Pass priority = 1:3 widen result include lower-confidence matches.

title: Working with Drug Specs
text: generics genuinely correspond one brand product — often GNRC_NM covers formulations approved different indications (e.g., semaglutide Ozempic type 2 diabetes vs. Wegovy chronic weight management). single generic can map zero, one, multiple brands, brand stored list-column: row’s brand value character vector, empty (character(0)) brand record. Build small example drug_spec() see action: Printing tibble shows <chr [1]>/<chr [0]> list-column rather brand text — ’s expected; str() indexing column (e.g., result$brand[[1]]) shows actual value(s). get one-row-per-brand tibble instead, use tidyr::unnest() keep_empty = TRUE — without keep_empty = TRUE, unnest() silently drops every row recorded brand, :
code: example_spec <- drug_spec(   drug_class    = "example",   label         = "Example GLP-1s",   generic_names_probable = c("SEMAGLUTIDE", "TIRZEPATIDE"),   generic_names_cautious = c("DULAGLUTIDE"),   brand_names = list(     SEMAGLUTIDE = "Ozempic",     TIRZEPATIDE = "Mounjaro"     # DULAGLUTIDE has no brand_names entry, so its brand is character(0)   ) )  example_spec$get_generics(priority = 1:3) #> # A tibble: 3 × 6 #>   generic     brand     priority condition class   version #>   <chr>       <list>       <int> <chr>     <chr>   <chr>   #> 1 SEMAGLUTIDE <chr [1]>        2 NA        example NA      #> 2 TIRZEPATIDE <chr [1]>        2 NA        example NA      #> 3 DULAGLUTIDE <chr [0]>        3 NA        example NA example_spec$get_generics(priority = 1:3) |>   tidyr::unnest(brand, keep_empty = TRUE) #> # A tibble: 3 × 6 #>   generic     brand    priority condition class   version #>   <chr>       <chr>       <int> <chr>     <chr>   <chr>   #> 1 SEMAGLUTIDE Ozempic         2 NA        example NA      #> 2 TIRZEPATIDE Mounjaro        2 NA        example NA      #> 3 DULAGLUTIDE NA              3 NA        example NA

title: peridefs 0.3.0
text: Collapsed hypertension, coronary heart disease (CHD), depression, diabetes specs single version (issue #4). Previously, specs multiple versions (e.g., spec_htn_v1/spec_htn_v2) shared identical codes differed narrative defs text (e.g., whether medication criterion included); remaining single version now carries complete (formerly highest-numbered) narrative. result, following exported functions package data objects removed: get_htn_v2_codes(), get_htn_v2_defs(), spec_htn_v2; get_depression_v2_codes(), get_depression_v2_defs(), spec_depression_v2; get_diabetes_v2_codes(), get_diabetes_v2_defs(), get_diabetes_v3_codes(), get_diabetes_v3_defs(), spec_diabetes_v2, spec_diabetes_v3; spec_ascvd composite longer "chd_v2" component ("chd_v1", now carrying merged definition). Use get_htn_v1_codes(), get_depression_v1_codes(), get_diabetes_v1_codes() (_defs() counterparts) going forward — now return current definition. CodeSpec$get_codes()/CompositeCodeSpec$get_codes() output (therefore get_ascvd_codes() similar composite accessors) longer duplicates version number inside class column. class now component’s unversioned condition identifier (e.g., "chd"), version continues hold version tag (e.g., "v1") separately — previously class held full versioned component key (e.g., "chd_v1"), duplicated information already present version. downstream code filtering class == "chd_v1"-style values needs filter class == "chd" version == "v1" instead.
